abstract_gate.question: Is the proposed verifier/oracle semantically capable of judging this case?
steps: never convert quarantined instrumentation cases into model/testbench failures

adjudication.claim: The same abstract instrument-applicability principle explains valid quarantines in both stdout judging and HDL mutation evaluation, but only the AtCoder/stdout line currently has prospective frozen transfer evidence.

domain: HDL mutation testing / CorrectBench-derived restricted oracle

quarantines.reason: Second continuous driver requires native Verilog 4-state/multiple-driver semantics; restricted Python oracle is not authoritative.
Mutant is behaviorally equivalent to the reference for the relevant semantics; treating it as a distinct kill target would invalidate the measurement denominator.

historical_derived_evidence.restricted_oracle: Python oracle restricted to unambiguous 2-state combinational semantics

next_prospective_test.failure: false quarantine, missed frozen-rule mismatch, or no transferable rule beyond domain-specific heuristics
next_prospective_test.requirement: Use a fresh non-AtCoder domain whose case metadata can be frozen before opening verifier-sensitive payloads.
next_prospective_test.success: prospectively identify at least one real applicability mismatch with zero false quarantines in the frozen sample
